reviews.review_title: This game is heaps of flying fun!
reviews.review_description:
I have been lucky enough to help beta test this game and I have to say that it is totally awesome! A lot of work has gone into building this and the developer has added lots of nice little things that make the game an absolute pleasure to play, like the radio in the background (with airport type songs) and the voices of the pilots and how the game talks to you and calls you Frank. 
It is great because it starts easy (there is a nice tutorial) and it gets more complex and challenging. 
I love the fact that you can actually stand in the control tower and watch the planes landing on the airstrips below (plus other modes available). There are also different times of the day and different weather to contend with, oh and it gives you marks on how efficient your route is and how accurate your landing is. 
I found it very immersive. It’s a top notch well built and well executed game. I can see it becoming a firm favourite.

reviews.review_title: Come in No 9 Your time is up....
reviews.review_description: Just love this game with a nod back to a classic game I used to play on my mobile phone over 15 years ago but now updated to fabulous VR. Moving the aircraft/helicopters to land at the right runway without colliding, thinking about those departing and just passing through the airspace in various weather conditions just awesome...

I love the challenge of getting all aircraft down safely, especially as things get more hectic with weather in each level. I find myself saying, “just one more go” lol.  There’s something pretty cool about having aeroplanes flying around your own living room, out  your windows, putting a helipad on a chair, a runway on the floor, another on the table then try to land everything safely so the mixed reality custom room sandbox option is a favourite! Definitely check it out!

reviews.review_title: Great fun and a challenge, very polished
reviews.review_description:
Wow, what a challenge. Those of you old enough to fondly remember the old iOS game "Flight Control" will be right at home with Vector Tango. It's a similar style air traffic control theme but provides so much more entertainment and depth with the added complexity of a 3D airspace... and a tad more stress at times for those with a competitive streak who like to test their skill against others. There's a poignant backstory behind the creation of this game which has helped shape it's direction (hint, it's a tribute to the developer's father and his work as an ATC). It really gives you an insight into the world of a real life Air Traffic Controller. 
The retro 3D diorama style graphics are best described as cute cartoony and can be easily scaled smaller or larger. The radio audio really adds to the immersion with a bunch of different radio voices and soundtracks and you can even adjust the sound stage to simulate a "tinny" radio or full stereo. You have the option to play in mixed reality (my preference) or full VR whereby your actions on the diorama play area are mimicked at life size outside the windows of the control tower (think of the game mechanic of "A Fisherman's Tale" and this will give you an idea of what I mean). Hand control feels like magic but I prefer to play with controllers as it gives you a little more accuracy, particularly towards the very end of the flightpath as when you un-pinch your fingers there's sometimes a little extra drawing you didn't intend.
There's even a sandbox option where you can set up your own room space with runways and landing pads, I'm looking forward to exploring that aspect more. Full disclosure, I was lucky enough to be a part of the beta testing team on this game and whilst I have no prior connection to the solo developer I really hope this game gets the attention it deserves. It's great fun and a real challenge for my 50ish year old brain. I can't stop playing, go buy it.

reviews.review_title: AN EXCELLENT GAME ONE OF A KIND
reviews.review_description:
A friend told me about the playtest and wow just plays so well, a mini airport in my lounge, the landings when done correctly are perfect, I enjoyed the playtest so much I shared it with my VR FB group.
Outstanding job, can’t wait for the campaign to start.

developer_response.body: Thank you so much! Excited for you to try the new campaign!

reviews.review_description:
Vector Tango is a fantastic new take on air traffic control gaming! It’s incredibly addictive, fun and challenging, and once you start playing, it really draws you in. You quickly find yourself completely immersed, trying to keep the skies organised and everything running smoothly.

One of the best features is the choice of playing in a full VR control tower or switching to Mixed Reality, bringing the experience right into your own space. You can use either hand tracking or controllers, which adds even more flexibility to how you play.

There are plenty of maps to explore, keeping things fresh and giving you loads to come back for. It’s a brilliant mix of strategy, quick thinking and multitasking that keeps you on your toes.

If you enjoy VR games that are easy to get into but challenging to master, Vector Tango is definitely worth checking out. Highly recommended!

reviews.review_title: A ton of fun and replayability!
reviews.review_description: It starts slow to help you get a feel, but before you know your navigating 3 different planes and a few helicopters around each other and the terrain. There’s even cities with skyscrapers to navigate around. And the weather! It’s a very fun and comprehensive game. Give it a try! Totally worth the price.
